description:
Proposed Extension Works
Property Address: 36 St Audrey Avenue, London, DA7 5BX
The proposed development comprises side and rear extensions to the existing dwelling, together with associated roof works, a new front porch, new rooflights and internal layout alterations. The purpose of the proposal is to provide additional habitable accommodation for the existing household in anticipation of potential future family growth, while improving the functionality, spatial quality and long-term adaptability of the property. 
A side extension is proposed at both ground floor and first floor levels to make better use of the available width of the site. At ground floor level, this will help provide an enlarged living area, while at first floor level it will support additional bedroom accommodation. The proposed side extension will align with the established front building line of the existing dwelling and continue towards the rear elevation, creating a coherent architectural form. 
To the rear, a ground floor extension of approximately 2,850mm beyond the existing rear external wall is proposed to provide an enlarged kitchen and dining area with improved usability and natural light. At first floor level, a rear extension of approximately 3,675mm beyond the existing rear external wall is proposed to accommodate two additional bedrooms and increase the residential capacity of the dwelling. 
A new front porch is proposed to create a more spacious and clearly defined entrance area. The proposed pitched roof form and architectural language have been designed to reflect the character of the existing property and surrounding residential context. A new roof extension will be introduced on the left-hand side of the existing pitched roof to partially cover the proposed side extension. Beyond the pitched roof, towards the rear of the property, a new flat roof is proposed to cover the remaining first floor side and rear extension areas. A further lower-level flat roof is proposed above the ground floor rear extension, primarily over the enlarged kitchen area. 
New rooflights/skylights are proposed above the new ground floor kitchen area and the first floor bathroom to enhance daylight penetration and improve internal environmental quality. 
Internally, the proposal introduces a more open-plan ground floor layout, incorporating a new reception area, enlarged kitchen and dining space, new utility room and guest WC. At first floor level, two additional bedrooms are proposed within the rear extension, increasing the total number of bedrooms to four. The existing master bedroom and bathroom will remain in their current locations, with the bathroom benefiting from the proposed rooflight. 
Overall, the proposed extensions have been designed to remain proportionate to the scale of the existing dwelling, improve the quality and capacity of the home, and minimise impacts onneighbouring properties where reasonably practicable.
